Instead of focusing on personal credit, Marco looked into **revenue-based financing**. With Delt Capital, the underwriting isn't based on an arbitrary FICO score. It’s based on the lifeblood of your business: your deposits and daily processing volume.

"I was pouring wine for a table on a Thursday night when I realized we could do 3x the volume if we just had the space," Marco says. "I applied for a merchant cash advance with Delt that night. By Friday afternoon, the funds were in my account."

The patio was finished in three weeks. Over the next year, Roma Trattoria saw a massive lift in revenue.

*   **Sales Increase:** 300% year-over-year

"It's not just about the money," Marco explains. "It's about having a partner that gets how fast this business moves. Delt gave us the fuel to grow when we needed it most."

*   **Revenue Growth:** 115% increase across both stores

"I'm a baker, not an accountant," Sarah notes. "Delt made the financial side simple so I could focus on the product."

**What is a merchant cash advance?**
An MCA is not a loan; it is an advance based upon the future revenues or credit card sales of a business. It provides fast capital in exchange for a percentage of daily sales.

posts.h1: How Page & Press Books Survived a Slow Winter with Revenue-Based Financing
posts.content_markdown:
Owning a bookstore-cafe is a dream for many, but the reality involves managing razor-thin margins and unpredictable foot traffic. For Marcus, owner of Page & Press Books, November and December were incredible months. But when January hit and the weather turned bitter, foot traffic plummeted. 

He had rent to pay, staff to keep on the payroll, and spring inventory to order. He didn't want to lay off his baristas, but the cash buffer from the holidays was shrinking fast. He needed a bridge, and he found it in **revenue-based financing**.

## The January Cash Flow Crunch

Every retail business knows the pain of the post-holiday slump. You do massive volume in Q4, but by mid-January, consumers are tightening their belts. 

"We had all these great new releases to order for the spring, but my bank account was looking light," Marcus explains. "A traditional bank loan felt like overkill. I just needed $15,000 to bridge the gap for six weeks, and I needed it fast."

He started looking for **small business funding fast** and discovered Delt Capital. 

## Why a Merchant Cash Advance Made Sense

Instead of a fixed term loan with a rigid monthly payment, Marcus opted for a **merchant cash advance** (MCA). 

With an MCA, repayment is completely tied to daily sales. If a blizzard hits on a Tuesday and nobody comes in to buy books, Marcus pays practically nothing that day. When the weekend crowd returns for lattes and paperbacks, a small, fixed percentage of those sales goes toward the advance.

"That flexibility is what sold me," Marcus says. "If I had a fixed $1,500 monthly payment to a bank, I'd be stressed out every time it snowed. With Delt, it just happens in the background."

### The Benefits of Revenue-Based Capital
*   **Stress-free repayment:** Aligns with your actual daily revenue.
*   **No fixed monthly overhead:** You aren't penalized for slow days.
*   **Fast underwriting:** Approved based on processing volume, not FICO.

## Upgrading the Retail Experience

While sorting out his funding, Marcus also evaluated his technology stack. A bookstore-cafe requires a unique setup—you need the **best POS for retail** to handle barcode scanning for books, but also fast tap-to-pay for the espresso bar.

He transitioned to [Delt Payments](/payments), unifying both sides of the business. 

According to benchmarking data from [Square](https://squareup.com/us/en/the-bottom-line/operating-your-business/how-well-are-you-really-doing-5-tips-for-benchmarking-your-business), managing multiple inventory types (like retail goods and food/beverage) efficiently is a major hurdle for hybrid businesses. Delt's unified system solved this overnight.

## The Results: A Smooth Spring Transition

The $15,000 advance allowed Marcus to keep all his staff on payroll through the winter and order his spring inventory without breaking a sweat. By April, as foot traffic picked up, the advance was naturally paid off.

*   **Capital Secured:** $15,000 in 24 hours
*   **Staff Retained:** 100% through the slow season
*   **Peace of Mind:** Priceless

"Delt gave me the breathing room to run my business the way I want to," Marcus says. "I didn't have to compromise on my staff or my stock."

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is revenue-based financing a loan?**
No, it is an advance against your future sales. You are selling a portion of your future revenue for immediate capital, which is why it doesn't function like traditional debt.

**How is a merchant cash advance repaid?**
A fixed percentage (known as the holdback rate) is automatically deducted from your daily credit card processing batches until the advance is fully paid.

**Why is an MCA good for seasonal businesses?**
Because repayment is tied to daily volume, you pay back less on slow days and more on busy days, protecting your cash flow during off-peak times.

---

They use confusing pricing models—often hiding massive markups in "non-qualified" tiers or padding their interchange-plus pricing with arbitrary monthly statement fees, PCI compliance fees, and batch fees.

"I called our processor to ask why our bill was $300 higher this month than the same month last year, even though our volume was identical," Tom says. "They put me on hold for 40 minutes, transferred me three times, and gave me some nonsense answer about network assessments. I was done."

*   **Next-Day Funding:** Getting the shop's money the next morning instead of waiting 48-72 hours.
*   **Modern Hardware:** Clean, tap-to-pay enabled terminals that look professional on the counter.

Because Delt automatically builds a customer database from payment data, Tom could suddenly see who his best customers were. He could track exactly who was coming in every Friday for dry-aged steaks. ## The Results: Modernizing a Classic

*   **Processing Fees:** Reduced by 22% overall

Instead of jumping through hoops for a traditional term loan, Delt Capital offered her a **merchant cash advance**. Because she used Delt for her payment processing, they could see the predictable, recurring revenue from her monthly memberships.

Tessa and her father, Tom, started their gelato shop with a single imported Italian batch freezer and a tiny storefront. Their pistachio gelato became a local obsession, and soon, lines were wrapping around the block.

They knew they needed to expand, but they were deeply risk-averse. Tom had spent decades saving for retirement, and he refused to put his house up as collateral for a traditional bank loan. 

"We wanted to grow, but we didn't want to risk everything we had already built," Tessa explains. "When the bank told us we needed a personal guarantee and a flawless FICO score to get capital, we walked out."

They needed to learn **how to get business funding without FICO** roadblocks. 

## The Power of Revenue-Based Financing

Tessa started researching alternative capital and found Delt. Because their shop processed a massive volume of small transactions—thousands of $6 gelato cups a week—they were perfect candidates for a **merchant cash advance**.

With an MCA, the underwriting isn't based on Tom's personal credit score or home equity. It is based entirely on the health of the business. 

"Delt looked at our processing data and saw exactly how much gelato we were selling," Tessa says. "They offered us the capital to secure the lease on our second location that same day."

If you need **small business funding fast**, a merchant cash advance provides unmatched speed because the data does the underwriting, not a loan committee.

## Expanding Without the Stress

Over the next three years, Tessa and Tom used **revenue-based financing** to systematically expand. Each time they stabilized a new location, they used their combined processing volume to secure an advance for the next one. 

Because the repayment is a fixed percentage of daily sales, the business was never stressed by large, fixed monthly payments. When it rained and they sold less gelato, they paid less that day. 

### Why Families Choose Revenue-Based Capital
*   **No Personal Collateral:** You aren't risking the family home.
*   **Scalability:** As your revenue grows, your access to capital grows.
*   **Speed:** Getting funded in 24 hours means you can jump on prime real estate opportunities before competitors.

## Unifying Operations Across 4 Stores

Managing four locations is exponentially harder than managing one. To keep operations smooth, Tessa deployed [Delt Payments](/payments) and the [Delt CRM](/crm) across all four stores. 

This allowed her to sit in the original shop and see real-time sales data for the entire enterprise. She could track exactly which flavors were selling at which locations and optimize their central kitchen's production schedule accordingly.

## The Results: A Local Empire

What started as a single storefront is now a local institution.

*   **Locations:** Grown from 1 to 4 stores
*   **Total Funding Speed:** Under 24 hours for each expansion
*   **Operational Ease:** Unified reporting across all locations

"We built this business with our own hands, and Delt gave us the fuel to multiply it," Tom says. "And the best part? I never had to sign away my house to do it."

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is a merchant cash advance?**
An MCA provides a business with a lump sum of capital in exchange for a percentage of its future credit card sales. It is a fast, flexible alternative to traditional bank loans.

Yes. Many retail and food businesses use the strong cash flow of their first location to secure an advance, which they then use to cover the build-out and equipment costs of a new location.
